name: g_jobHandlers
notes: Handler table used by DispatchJob (0x41D670).

name: g_frameCorrectionStepMs
notes: 0.2 in the file. Step for the frame time correction.

name: g_frameCorrectionLimitMs
notes: 10.0 in the file. The correction g_frameCorrectionMs is clamped to +/- this value.

name: g_frameTimeMs
notes: Target frame time, 16.6667 (= 1000/60) in the file. Read at 0x4A4B8F. Only the initial value is confirmed.

name: g_targetFps
notes: 60 in the file.

name: g_frameCorrectionThresholdMs
notes: 20 in the file. Threshold used when deciding the frame time correction.

name: g_frameCorrectionPeriodMs
notes: 333 in the file. Period of the frame time correction decision.

name: g_defaultHglCoreIniName
notes: Points to the default file name "hglCore.ini" used by GetHglCoreIniPath.

name: g_jobQueueRead
notes: Read index of g_jobQueue. The queue is empty when it equals g_jobQueueWrite. Code: hod2::kJobQueueReadIndex.

name: g_jobQueueWrite
notes: Write index of g_jobQueue. Code: hod2::kJobQueueWriteIndex.

name: g_jobQueue
notes: Ring buffer of 64 entries, 16 bytes each, processed by ProcessJobQueueEntry. Entry layout unknown.

name: g_diDevices
notes: Array of DirectInput device pointers (controllers / light guns). SetCooperativeLevel at 0x41EBA3 takes the device from here.

name: g_cdCheckMode
notes: CheckCdRom passes immediately when this is 0. Meaning unknown.

name: g_hWnd
notes: Main window handle, stored at 0x4A588D from CreateWindowExA. Window class and title are both "The House of the Dead 2".

name: g_frameWaitCallback
notes: Function pointer called by WaitFrameEnd with the remaining ms on every spin; void __cdecl (float). Set to FrameWaitCallback at 0x49DF0B. Code: hod2::kFrameWaitCallbackSlot.

name: g_hglCoreFlags
notes: hglCore.ini flag bits set by LoadHglCoreIni. Bit table in docs/work/reverse-engineering.md.

name: g_frameCorrectionMs
notes: Accumulated frame time correction, clamped to +/- 10 ms.

name: g_lastFrameQpcLow
notes: Low 32 bits of the QueryPerformanceCounter value of the previous frame.

name: g_qpcFrequency
notes: QueryPerformanceFrequency value.

name: g_hglCoreIniPath
notes: Full path of hglCore.ini written by GetHglCoreIniPath.
